dataset: Per-record outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM), every BBQ run with method multiple_choice_joint, joined to the BBQ data and analysis_scripts/additional_metadata.csv of github.com/nyu-mll/BBQ (CC BY 4.0). Only ids, categories, letters, counts and public model names are published.
note: H = HELM v0.2.2's BBQMetric with HELM's tags (reproduces the published values); A = ambiguous bias scaled by 1 - accuracy on ambiguous questions (#4372); T = target and non-target letters from the BBQ authors' target_loc (#4368); AT = both. Each value is the mean over the run's trials, as HELM publishes it. Ranks: 1 + number of models with a strictly lower value (HELM marks the BBQ bias columns lower-is-better).
